mode.description: Task mode for Proteina-Complexa: `protein_binder` designs binders to a protein target; `ligand_binder` designs binders around a small-molecule pocket; `motif` scaffolds a functional motif into a larger protein.

target_pdb.description: Target structure PDB. Required for `protein_binder` (the receptor) and `ligand_binder` (a structure containing the ligand pocket).

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` (or `motif_pdb` in motif mode) when those direct inputs are omitted.

target_chain.description: Single-letter chain id on `target_pdb` to design against.

target_pocket_residues.description: ligand_binder only: target pocket residue positions. Interpreted as FASTA/sequence 1-indexed positions when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy PDB residue numbers.

target_pocket_residue_ids.description: ligand_binder only: explicit pocket residue identifiers `<chain><resnum>[icode]`.

target_sequence.description: Reference target sequence for mapping integer pocket residues onto PDB residue IDs.

target_fasta_path.description: FASTA file containing the target sequence. Alternative to inline `target_sequence`.

ligand_smiles.description: ligand_binder only: SMILES string of the ligand whose pocket the binder is designed around.

motif_pdb.description: motif only: PDB containing the functional motif residues that must be preserved in the designed protein.

motif_chain.description: Single-letter chain id on `motif_pdb` holding the motif residues.

motif_residues.description: motif only: positions to preserve. Interpreted as FASTA/sequence 1-indexed positions when `motif_sequence`/`motif_fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy PDB residue numbers.

motif_residue_ids.description: motif only: explicit motif residue identifiers `<chain><resnum>[icode]`.

motif_sequence.description: Reference sequence for the motif chain, used for mapping integer `motif_residues` onto PDB residue IDs.

motif_fasta_path.description: FASTA file for the motif sequence; alternative to inline `motif_sequence`.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer position inputs. `auto` picks sequence when a target/motif sequence is provided, else structure; `sequence` forces 1-indexed FASTA positions; `structure` forces legacy PDB residue numbering.

total_length.description: motif only: total length of the designed monomer (motif + scaffold).

binder_length.description: Length of the designed binder chain in residues (protein_binder, ligand_binder).

num_designs.description: Candidate count. Null preserves the mode-specific default: protein_binder=4, ligand_binder=2, motif=10.

seed.description: Optional integer RNG seed for reproducibility.

run_name.description: Optional human-friendly run name written into the artifact directory. Null lets the adapter generate one.

search_algorithm.description: Generation search strategy. `default` preserves the upstream mode config; `single-pass` is useful for small smoke runs; richer strategies (`best-of-n`, `beam-search`, `mcts`) increase quality at higher cost.

reward_model.description: Reward model policy. `default` preserves the upstream config; `none` disables reward scoring/guidance for fast compatibility smoke runs.

steps.description: Optional Proteina-Complexa pipeline steps to run. Null preserves the adapter default for the selected mode; `[generate, filter]` is useful for fast design-only smoke runs.
